newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bono/Bund spread declines to another record low.
newsitem.headline: Bono/Bund spread declines to another record low.

text.p: The 10-year Spanish bono spread over Bunds dipped on Monday to a record low at 128 basis points.
The previous record was set on Friday at 130 basis points.

In the cash market the 10-year 8.80 percent benchmark was trading at 111.11 versus 111.12 at the close on Friday, with a yield at 7.11 percent. The long-term futures contract was trading up eight basis points from Friday at 111.28.
